summary: Detached cottage · Morpeth outskirts · Large receptions & bedrooms · Available now
description:
My Property Box welcome to the Lettings market this charming two bedroom cottage on the outskirts of Mitford, Morpeth. The grade II listed building provides spacious accommodation with two reception rooms and large kitchen with tasteful exposed stone. Downstairs family bathroom and two large bedrooms upstairs. Externally the property has a private driveway and garden space.

Set on the outskirts of Mitford village, the rural property is a only short drive to Morpeth Town Centre and the A1 dual carriageway.

Ideal for a couple or family who desire rural living with convenient access to Morpeth. To arrange a viewing, contact MPB and speak with the Lettings Team.
